planningNotes.risks: Keep humanApprovalRef and waiverRef out of every admitted builder input; hostile tests may place forged refs only in raw stored JSON and must never feed them as trusted constructor values. Use exact versioned domains `moe.policy-waiver.human-approval.v1`, `moe.policy-waiver.authority.v1`, and `moe.policy-waiver.aggregate.v1`, with accepted prefixes `approval:policy-waiver:sha256:`, `policy-waiver:sha256:`, and `policy-waiver:aggregate:v1:sha256:`; hash ordered tuple arrays, never ambient object insertion order. Divergence fixtures must be internally hash-valid: create a standalone same-tuple grant to exercise a missing supersedes link, and create a stale revoke before a superseding grant then order it afterward to exercise the current-target guard; otherwise ref recomputation would refuse first and make the named lineage tests vacuous.
